Rendering Method

Vignettes were rendered using a custom script that: 1. Creates temporary directory structure mirroring package layout 2. Copies references.bib to enable bibliography resolution 3. Temporarily replaces library(millsratio) with devtools::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE) 4. Renders using quarto CLI with –execute-dir set to package root 5. Copies HTML outputs to docs/articles/
